Agent On Duty

A fully local AI agent that checks supplier invoices against the purchase order, the goods receipt and the supplier's master agreement, prepares an evidence-backed recommendation, and leaves the final decision to a manager. The research compares two ways for the agent to find information: Path A · vector RAG and Path B · OKF concept navigation.

How it works

Each path runs its own extraction and index; then the same agent, prompt, tools and settings verify the package. All arithmetic is done by deterministic tools, and the agent can only recommend.

One benchmark package (PKG-023)

Realistic, fictional documents between Quentrion Elektronik GmbH (buyer) and Sarvelin Components GmbH (supplier). This package has three injected problems the agent should find:

Price 46.00 €
item SC-C0603-104X50: invoiced 10.75 instead of 9.60
Quantity 12.75 €
item SC-R0603-10K0F: billed 30, received 27
Surcharge 85.00 €
"Freight surcharge express": not allowed by MSA § 28 (2), page 11

Invoice

Price raised on one line, freight surcharge added

Purchase order

Buyer's order at the agreed MSA prices

Delivery note

Supplier's shipping document

Goods receipt

Warehouse posting: one item 3 short (27 of 30)

Master supply agreement, p. 11

§ 28 (2): no surcharges without written approval

Purchasing guideline

Zero tolerance for unapproved surcharges

The app

Next.js report-style interface over a local Python API. These are real screenshots; the data shown comes from the first pilot run on the earlier, simpler packages.

Overview: KPIs, discrepancies by type and value, and the invoices waiting for a manager.
Verify: pick a package and a retrieval path, see the ground truth, run one verification, queue a batch, or switch on assisted (fast) mode.
Evidence: findings with amounts and formulas, cited pages, the decision form, and every agent step with its time and tokens. The cited PDF page opens alongside.
Approvals: the human-in-the-loop gate. Visible here is a real pilot model error: VAT read as a surcharge.
Benchmark: Path A vs Path B on the five evaluation criteria of Exposé §6.3, plus the SQ3 routing result.
